Independent modular inclusion-exclusion exact integers checked all odd-base residues and 12 critical valuation witnesses for (N,b)=(10,1),(10,2),(11,1), t=1..4; calculation uses modular numerator divided by 2^11 then invert odd factorial.
Finite witnesses corroborate the structural 2-adic isometry proof; no finite test is claimed to imply unbounded t.
correctness.rationale: In inclusion–exclusion for S(n,15), split odd/even bases. For n multiple16, factor even bases to 2^n(T(n)+2^n U(n)); T(n)≡64 mod128, so ν2(E(n))=n−5. For odd bases Q_j(10)=(j^1024−1)/2^12 residues mod2048 are 573,415,374,1146,1355,1137,988 for j=3,5,7,9,11,13,15; binomial weighted sum is 1024 mod2048 and stable with higher r. Therefore odd-base difference after shift h2^N has ν2=N+ν2(h)+1. Scaling by H at critical exponent e=H−N−1 makes Φ:Z2→Z2 an isometry; reduction modulo each 2^t proves surjectivity and unique odd center rho for odd η=E(b2^N)/2^H. For odd u≡rho+2^t mod2^(t+1), choose large representative so even-base remainder is more divisible than 2^(H+t); obtain all and only valuations H+t,t>=1.
